jobs.title: Executive Director Underwriting
jobs.description:
Executive Director Underwriting
Minimum Qualification and Experience:
ACII or FCII, with at least fifteen years of relevant post qualification experience with an insurer/reinsurer, out of which five years must be as a Key Officer of an insurer/reinsurer.
OR
Master's degree or 16 years of education in Insurance, Risk Management, Finance, or M.Com Insurance from an HEC recognized university, with at least twenty years of post qualification experience with an insurer/reinsurer, out of which five years must be as a Key Officer of an insurer/reinsurer.
OR
Fellow or Associate Member of the Casualty Actuarial Society, the Institute of Actuaries in England, or the Society of Actuaries in the United States of America, with at least fifteen years of relevant post qualification experience, out of which five years must be as a Key Officer of an insurer/reinsurer.
Job Type: Performance based contract for a period of three years, with a competitive market based compensation package, to be mutually decided during the interview, commensurate with the candidate's relevant and verifiable experience.
Vacancies/Slots: 01
Max. Age Limit Required: Maximum 57 years of age as on the closing date of the advertisement.
IMPORTANT NOTES
Pakistan Reinsurance Company Limited PRCL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
The appointment will be on a performance-based contract for a period of three years. The selected candidate will be paid a competitive market-based compensation package, to be mutually decided during the interview, commensurate with the candidate's relevant and verifiable experience.
Interested applicants may apply online at https://www.njp.gov.pk within fifteen days of the publication of this advertisement by uploading their updated CV/resume along with a copy of CNIC, academic/professional degrees and transcripts, and experience certificates. In case of any difficulty encountered in online application, please contact the HR Department at the phone number or email address stated below.
Original documents along with HEC verified testimonials will be required at the time of the interview.
The candidate shall not be entitled to any TA/DA while appearing for the interview.
PRCL reserves the right to stop the hiring process at any stage without assigning any reason.
Only shortlisted applicants will be invited for an interview, and selection will be finalized as per the approved policy of PRCL.
